RESEARCH fire-246 EVEN: Tabular Foundation Models for Conditional Density Estimation — arXiv:2603.26611 (Mar 2026). Benchmarks TabPFN/TabICL on 39 real-world datasets using 6 proper scoring metrics (Brier, CRPS, CRLS, log-score, interval score, calibration error). Key finding: model rankings shift substantially by scoring rule — Brier winner may lose on CRPS/CRLS. App1: Add all 6 metrics to /api/export. App2: Multi-metric Pareto frontier (Brier+CRPS+CRLS+calibration_error). App3: Validate S18 RF-200f-0.21949 and S22 ET-0.2193 under CRPS/CRLS before fleet-best claim. App4: TabICLv2 re-evaluation on 186f NBA dataset with 6 metrics. App5: Port scoring suite to political_engine.py for rare-event calibration. Library: properscoring + netcal/calibration-uncertainty. Expected: 0.001-0.003 Brier. Proposal: data/research-proposals/sota-tabular-fm-density-estimation-fire246.md.

Library: crepes/nonconformist + ~50 lines custom Hoeffding wrapper. Expected: 0.001-0.002 Brier. Proposal: data/research-proposals/sota-conformal-calibration-reuse-fire244.md.
